title: Temporal Mechanics
description: The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

puzzle.goal: A gas is released into a larger container and its microstates spread out. Before, microstate j had probability q_j; afterwards it has probability p_j. Write the change in entropy as the statistical entropy of the final distribution minus that of the initial one, each built from the probabilities and their logarithms.
puzzle.name: Gibbs entropy change (statistical arrow of time)
puzzle.form: - kB * sumk ( j , p _ j * ln ( p _ j ) ) + kB * sumk ( j , q _ j * ln ( q _ j ) )
puzzle.ask: For an ideal gas filling all accessible states equally, this becomes nR ln(V₂/V₁). Find the entropy increase when n = @{n} mol expands freely from V₁ = 1 L to V₂ = 3 L.
puzzle.method: Each microstate contributes −kB·p·ln p; subtract the initial sum from the final one.
